site_name: St Edwards C Of E Primary School
description:
GRP1 - Sycamores, Ash, Prunus, Holly, Elders and mixed vegetation growing though wire mesh fence line - approx. 18+ Trees
All trees growing along and through wire fence line (marked in pink paint) reduce by approx. 1.8m to height of wire mesh fence.
Reduce any shrubs and vegetation that encroaches into Play area to be faced back to fence line in order to erect a new
perimeter fence.
Any stumps that have been previously felled by 3rd party (on school side only) poison with Eco plugs.
Tree work is to be undertaken to remove dead branches to improve form and increase safety in accordance with good
arboriculture practice and maintain the future wellbeing and growth of the trees
